findings.title: Unauthenticated access returns data: GET /api/notes/
findings.evidence: REQUEST: GET http://localhost:8124/api/notes/ -> RESPONSE: 200 [{"id":1,"note":"public note data here"}]
findings.fix: Require authentication on views.PublicNotes (permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated] / @login_required). Authenticated control call also succeeded, so the route is live.

findings.title: DEBUG=True in Django settings
findings.fix: Set DEBUG=False in production (env-gated: DEBUG = os.environ.get('DEBUG') == '1').

findings.title: Hardcoded Django SECRET_KEY
findings.fix: Load from env/secret manager (SECRET_KEY = os.environ['SECRET_KEY']); rotate the exposed value.

findings.title: hardcoded_tmp_directory [B108]
findings.fix: Review flagged construct against bandit docs; apply safe alternative and re-scan.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
findings.fix: Add a CSP header, e.g. Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'.

findings.title: No rate limiting observed (20 rapid requests, all accepted)
findings.evidence: 20x GET / in burst: all 200, no 429, no Retry-After/X-RateLimit headers.
findings.fix: Add throttling (DRF DEFAULT_THROTTLE_CLASSES / django-ratelimit / reverse-proxy limit_req).

findings.title: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE not set (defaults to False)
findings.evidence: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE absent; Django default sends cookies over HTTP.

findings.title: CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE not set (defaults to False)
findings.evidence: CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE absent; Django default sends cookies over HTTP.

findings.title: hardcoded_password_string [B105]
findings.evidence:
6 DEBUG = True  # CFG-01 (deliberate)
7 SECRET_KEY = "drf-sample-hardcoded-key-for-proof-only"  # CFG-03 (deliberate)
8 ALLOWED_HOSTS = ["*"]  # CFG-02 (deliberate)
findings.fix: Move secret to env var; fail closed if unset.

findings.title: Missing HSTS header
findings.fix: Serve over HTTPS, then add Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains (serve over HTTPS).

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
Missing X-Frame-Options header
findings.fix: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN) to block clickjacking.

findings.title: Server/framework version disclosed (Server: WSGIServer/0.2 CPython/3.14.2)
findings.fix: Suppress version banners (e.g. server_tokens off; remove X-Powered-By).
